subject: Guard only permanent NFI plot data, per SLU's licence
description: Tobias decided on 2026-11-03 that the NFI location rule follows the licence. ImintEngine uses only SLU's calibration subset of temporary plots (swe_nfi_plotdata2.xlsx), which SLU publishes as open data under CC0 1.0 with plot positions; only permanent plots' exact coordinates are confidential and released under agreement. The hygiene guards were written on the permanent-plot premise. Scope: tests/test_repo_hygiene.py replaces the data/nfi, parquet-column and tile-name/coordinate guards with one guard against tracked permanent-plot data (data/nfi_permanent/ or permanent-plot file names), with pattern tests; .gitignore comment and a data/nfi_permanent/ entry. Not in scope: restoring the files task 0140 moved to the private experiments repo. Review: Codex.
